learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn that every single thing around us has a name!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Every person has a name! You are a child. Mother, teacher, and doctor are naming words for people.
We go to many beautiful places. A park, a zoo, and a house are naming words for places we visit.
Animals and birds have names too! A dog, a fish, and a lion are naming words for animals.
We use and play with many things. A toy, a pencil, and an apple are naming words for things.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 I Spy Naming Words!
fun_activity.instructions: Look around your room like a secret spy! Point to 3 things you see and say their names out loud. Can you find a toy, a book, or a bed?

quick_recap: ⭐ Everything in the world has a name.
⭐ Names of people, places, animals, and things are called Naming Words.
